correctness.rationale: PASS — On a connected graph a primitive two-cycle has complementary first/second firing sets by the Laplacian kernel. For a given binary first firing set S, each vertex has c_v cross-cut neighbors and exactly c_v legal initial chip heights, all independently choosable and weighted by z^{3f+(1−f)(3−c)}[c]_z. The 16-state row-column transfer uses successive binary rung columns; trace T^n/2 counts prism orbits and trace T^n J/2 counts the twisted seam. The anti-row-swap restriction is 6-dimensional and has exact polynomial characteristic factor (λ²−z^10)(λ²+λ z³(1+z)²−z^8)(λ²+λ z⁵(1+z)²−z^12). I independently constructed and symbolically checked this matrix/determinant from the formula, not from saved log, and independently expanded trace coefficients n=3,…,7; signed coefficients are strictly positive on all 4n+1 supported exponents and zero outside, with center +4/−2. Lucas root recurrence yields integer n/(n−j)binom(n−j,j) and all-n coefficientwise sign by the j=0 term. Complementing chip heights by 5−x gives z^10n reciprocity. The finite tests corroborate an all-n characteristic-polynomial argument; n≥3 avoids degeneracies.
